name: BT Accounts
changelog:
0.2.1

  • BT Accounts now sits with the other BT plugins in the admin sidebar instead of drifting up beside Analytics.
  • Registers itself with BT Quote's grouping via the new bt_menu_group_order filter, and falls back to a menu position beside BT Quote if that grouping is unavailable.

0.2.0

  • Portal restyled on Boomer T's branding — navy #27267e, magenta accents, Oswald headings and Tahoma body, matching the Quick Quote tool.
  • Sign-in page rebuilt: navy gradient, branded header card, magenta sign-in button.
  • Portal header now leads with Boomer T's and shows the account's logo in a chip edged with their brand colour.
  • Optional Boomer T's logo setting (BT Accounts → Portal branding); falls back to the Oswald wordmark.
  • Footer pinned to the bottom on short pages.

0.1.0

  • Phase 1 skeleton: contract account portal at /accounts.
  • Portal logins are self-contained — not WordPress users, no wp-admin access, no capabilities anywhere in WordPress.
  • Accounts admin screen: branding, PO requirement, garment-purchase flag, per-account logins.
  • Per-account pricing rides BT Quote's existing btq_pricing_tables filter, so the engine is not forked and the public quoter is unaffected.
  • Login throttling, hashed sessions, per-session CSRF tokens, nocache headers on every portal response.
